source.title: Methadone administration and QT interval prolongation: protocol for a systematic review and meta-analysis

extraction_notes: No quantitative_result atoms were created because this publication is a protocol and reports no results generated by the planned systematic review/meta-analysis.
Quantitative findings cited from prior studies in the Introduction/Discussion were treated as background secondary reports and were not reclassified as results generated by this protocol.

The source contains an internal evidence-certainty-method inconsistency: the abstract names GRADE, whereas the Methods section names Evidence-based Practice Center programme guidelines. Both statements were preserved as separate method atoms for review.
